summary.text: Isaac Schultz is a Republican state representative from Minnesota who has represented House District 10B since 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
An auctioneer and former district director for Congressman Pete Stauber, he served as president of the Minnesota State Auctioneers Association.

paragraphs.text: Isaac Schultz earned a B.S. in marketing from the University of Northwestern in 2013.
His career experience includes working as an auctioneer with Schultz Auctioneers Landmark Realty and Kurt Johnson Auctioneering, Inc., and as the district director for Congressman Pete Stauber.

He served as president of the Minnesota State Auctioneers Association and has been affiliated with the National Auctioneers Association, Sons of the American Legion, the Boys and Girls Club, the National Rifle Association and the Minnesota Gun Owners Caucus.
Schultz took office in the Minnesota House of Representatives on January 3, 2023, succeeding Dale Lueck.
The Republican primary for his seat on August 11, 2026, was canceled.
In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Schultz described himself as a fifth-generation resident of the district and a third-generation auctioneer working in his family's business.
He said he had been involved in the local Republican Party for more than a decade.
